blocks.text: Zyada tar insani bimariyan jaraseemi infections se hoti hain: viruses, bimari paida karne wale bacteria, phaphoond (fungi) ya protists ka jism par hamla. Infections aur cancers se bachne ke liye vertebrates mein immune system hai jo khoon mein bairooni cells aur molecules ki musalsal jaanch karta hai. Infection pakarne par yeh hamla awaron ko tabah karta hai; isi liye ise kamzor karne wali bimariyan, jaise AIDS, bohat khatarnak hain.

blocks.alt: Teer se jure teen rangeen column. Pehli line, ghair makhsoos rukawatein: jild, mucous membranes, tezaab, lysozyme aur cilia. Doosri line, ghair makhsoos, jism ke andar: jaraseem maar cells, hifazati proteins, sozish aur bukhar. Teesri line, makhsoos immune system: T cells, B cells aur antibodies, yaad.
blocks.caption: Difa ki teen lines (Figure 21.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jism ki hifazat ki teen lines hain. Pehli, jild aur hazme aur saans ki naliyon ki tehein apne tezaab, lysozyme, balgham aur cilia ke saath, jaraseem ko bahar rakhti hai. Jo jaraseem guzar jayen woh doosri line se milte hain: jaraseem maar cells, hifazati proteins, sozish aur bukhar. Yeh do lines ghair makhsoos hain, har hamla awar ke khilaf. Teesri line, T cells, B cells aur antibodies ka immune system, makhsoos hai: yeh khaas jaraseem ko nishana banati aur yaad rakhti hai, is liye agli baar tez jawab deti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: mehfooz shehar
blocks.text: Jism ki hifazat shehar ki tarah hoti hai: deewarein dakhila mushkil karti hain, gasht karti police ajnabiyon ko jaanchti hai, aur security guard baghair shanakht wale ko rok kar police bulate hain. Jism ki bhi isi tarah difa ki kai lines hain.
Difa ki pehli line jild, hazme ki nali aur saans ki nali par mushtamil hai.

blocks.prompt: Difa ki pehli line kis par mushtamil hai?
blocks.explanation: Jild aur hazme aur saans ki naliyon ki tehein.

items: Immune system infections aur cancers se bachata hai.
Teen lines: rukawatein, ghair makhsoos andaruni difa, makhsoos immunity.
